images.title: Following a curved lane
images.description: At the bend, the selected yellow trajectory turns with the lane. The blue candidate set spreads over different curvatures, while the white human reference offers a geometric comparison.

images.title: Keeping a compact forward plan
images.description: On the straight street, the selected path stays close to the cluster of forward candidates. The paired bird’s-eye view makes the lateral spacing near the curb easier to inspect.

images.title: Resolving a branching junction
images.description: Candidate paths fan out toward different exits at the junction. The selected yellow path continues ahead, separating the chosen route from the alternatives that turn across the road.

images.title: Tracing the bridge curvature
images.description: The plan follows the road’s gradual bend beside opposing traffic. The camera view and bird’s-eye map show how the selected trajectory aligns with the lane through the curve.

intro.title: DriveTTO | Search, planning and closed-loop driving
intro.selection: A five-minute introduction to DriveTTO: the complete algorithm animation, four NAVSIM plans at PDMS 100, and thirteen complete HUGSIM episodes with RC 100 and HD-Score 94.2–100. Original instrumental music accompanies the film; 14 complete rollouts are available in the gallery.
intro.note: Recorded driving retains complete episodes at original playback speed. RC/HD scores describe those complete episodes. Main-video views crop the front camera; gallery videos retain all six views. Schematic method animation is not a measured trajectory. These selected high-score examples are illustrative; aggregate experiment results are unchanged.
